import requests
import json

# ============= CONFIG =============
EVENTS_API = "http://192.168.56.10:8888"
GROQ_API = "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions"
GROQ_API_KEY = "<GROQ_API_KEY>"
GROQ_MODEL = "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"

# ============= INPUT FROM SHUFFLE =============
agent_id = "$exec.all_fields.agent.id"
agent_name = "$exec.all_fields.agent.name"
current_rule_id = "$exec.all_fields.rule.id"
current_rule_desc = "$exec.all_fields.rule.description"
current_rule_level = "$exec.all_fields.rule.level"
playbook = "$routeur.body.playbook"

THREAT_TO_SEVERITY = {
    "LOW": 1,
    "MEDIUM": 2,
    "HIGH": 3,
    "CRITICAL": 4
}

result = {
    "ai_analysis": {},
    "thehive_severity": 2,
    "timeline": [],
    "error": None,
    "status": "ok"
}

# ============= 1. GET RECENT EVENTS =============
try:
    r = requests.get(
        f"{EVENTS_API}/agent/{agent_id}/recent",
        params={"limit": 10, "suspicious_only": "true"},
        timeout=10
    )
    r.raise_for_status()
    events_data = r.json()
    timeline = events_data.get("alerts", [])
    result["timeline"] = timeline
except Exception as e:
    result["error"] = f"Failed to fetch timeline: {str(e)}"
    timeline = []

# ============= 2. BUILD PROMPT =============
timeline_text = ""
for i, ev in enumerate(timeline[:10]):
    eid = ev.get("eventID", "")
    rid = ev.get("rule_id", "")
    desc = ev.get("description", "")
    tact = ", ".join(ev.get("mitre_tactic", [])) or "N/A"
    tech = ", ".join(ev.get("mitre_technique", [])) or "N/A"
    edata = ev.get("eventdata", {})
    subject = edata.get("subjectUserName", "")
    target = edata.get("targetUserName", "")
    member_sid = edata.get("memberSid", "")
    ts = ev.get("timestamp", "")[:19] if ev.get("timestamp") else ""
    user_str = ""
    if subject:
        user_str += f" | actor: {subject}"
    if target:
        user_str += f" | target_group: {target}"
    if member_sid:
        user_str += f" | member_sid: {member_sid}"
    timeline_text += f"  {i+1}. [{ts}] Rule {rid} (EID {eid}): {desc} | MITRE tactic: {tact} | technique: {tech}{user_str}\n"

if not timeline_text:
    timeline_text = "  (No recent suspicious events found)\n"

prompt = f"""Tu es un analyste SOC senior. Analyse cette CHAINE d'evenements sur l'agent {agent_name}.

EVENEMENT DECLENCHEUR:
- Regle: {current_rule_id} - {current_rule_desc}
- Niveau Wazuh: {current_rule_level}

TIMELINE DES 10 DERNIERS EVENEMENTS SUSPECTS (du plus recent au plus ancien):
{timeline_text}

IMPORTANT:
1. Tu DOIS inclure le champ "events_detail" avec UNE ENTREE PAR EVENEMENT. OBLIGATOIRE.
2. Pour "mitre_tactics_observed", toujours inclure le code T avec le nom (ex: "T1136 - Create Account", "T1484 - Domain Policy Modification"). Ne jamais mettre juste le nom sans le code T.
3. Pour "mitre_technique" dans events_detail, toujours inclure le code T (ex: "T1484 - Domain Policy Modification").

Reponds UNIQUEMENT en JSON valide (pas de markdown):
{{
  "chain_detected": true,
  "attack_pattern": "Privilege Escalation",
  "events_correlated": 10,
  "summary": "Resume en 2-3 phrases en francais",
  "threat_level": "CRITICAL",
  "confidence_percent": 95,
  "is_likely_false_positive": false,
  "recommended_actions": ["Action 1", "Action 2", "Action 3"],
  "mitre_tactics_observed": ["T1136 - Create Account", "T1484 - Domain Policy Modification"],
  "analyst_priority": "P1",
  "events_detail": [
    {{
      "timestamp": "2026-06-28T12:10:12",
      "rule_id": "60154",
      "description": "Administrators Group Changed",
      "mitre_tactic": "Privilege Escalation",
      "mitre_technique": "T1484 - Domain Policy Modification",
      "user": "void (actor) ajoute dans Administrators (target)",
      "significance": "Un compte a ete ajoute au groupe Administrateurs — escalade de privileges critique"
    }},
    {{
      "timestamp": "2026-06-28T12:10:11",
      "rule_id": "60109",
      "description": "User account enabled or created",
      "mitre_tactic": "Persistence",
      "mitre_technique": "T1136 - Create Account",
      "user": "void (actor) a cree le compte backdoor",
      "significance": "Creation d un nouveau compte utilisateur suspect"
    }}
  ]
}}

Remplis events_detail avec TOUS les evenements de la timeline fournie ci-dessus, un objet par evenement."""

# ============= 3. CALL GROQ =============
try:
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {GROQ_API_KEY}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    body = {
        "model": GROQ_MODEL,
        "messages": [
            {"role": "system", "content": "Tu es un analyste SOC senior. Tu reponds UNIQUEMENT en JSON valide. Tu dois TOUJOURS inclure le champ events_detail avec une entree pour chaque evenement de la timeline. Pour mitre_tactics_observed et mitre_technique, toujours inclure le code T (ex: T1136, T1484) suivi du nom."},
            {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
        ],
        "temperature": 0.3,
        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}
    }

    resp = requests.post(GROQ_API, headers=headers, json=body, timeout=30)

    if resp.status_code == 200:
        groq_response = resp.json()
        ai_text = groq_response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        try:
            result["ai_analysis"] = json.loads(ai_text)
        except json.JSONDecodeError:
            result["ai_analysis"] = {"raw": ai_text, "parse_error": True}
            result["error"] = "AI returned invalid JSON"
    else:
        result["error"] = f"Groq API error {resp.status_code}"
        result["ai_analysis"] = {
            "chain_detected": len(timeline) >= 3,
            "attack_pattern": "AI unavailable - basic detection",
            "events_correlated": len(timeline),
            "summary": f"AI service indisponible. {len(timeline)} evenements suspects detectes.",
            "threat_level": "MEDIUM",
            "confidence_percent": 50,
            "is_likely_false_positive": False,
            "recommended_actions": ["Investiguer manuellement"],
            "mitre_tactics_observed": [],
            "analyst_priority": "P3",
            "events_detail": []
        }

except Exception as e:
    result["error"] = f"Groq call failed: {str(e)}"
    result["ai_analysis"] = {
        "chain_detected": False,
        "attack_pattern": "Error",
        "summary": f"Erreur d'analyse: {str(e)}",
        "threat_level": "UNKNOWN",
        "confidence_percent": 0,
        "is_likely_false_positive": False,
        "recommended_actions": ["Investiguer manuellement"],
        "mitre_tactics_observed": [],
        "analyst_priority": "P3",
        "events_detail": []
    }

# ============= 4. COMPUTE THEHIVE SEVERITY =============
ai_threat = result["ai_analysis"].get("threat_level", "MEDIUM")
result["thehive_severity"] = THREAT_TO_SEVERITY.get(ai_threat, 2)

# ============= 5. RETURN =============
print(json.dumps(result, default=str))

import requests
import json

# ============= CONFIG =============
GROQ_API = "https://api.groq.com/openai/v1/chat/completions"
GROQ_API_KEY = "<GROQ_API_KEY>"
GROQ_MODEL = "llama-3.3-70b-versatile"

# ============= INPUT FROM SHUFFLE =============
score = "$calc_score.body.score"
severity = "$calc_score.body.severity"
recommended_action = "$calc_score.body.recommended_action"
agent_name = "$exec.all_fields.agent.name"
agent_id = "$exec.all_fields.agent.id"
rule_id = "$exec.all_fields.rule.id"
rule_desc = "$exec.all_fields.rule.description"
rule_level = "$exec.all_fields.rule.level"
firedtimes = "$exec.all_fields.rule.firedtimes"
srcip = "$exec.all_fields.data.srcip"
playbook = "$routeur.body.playbook"
vt_detail = "$calc_score.body.details.vt.detail"
otx_detail = "$calc_score.body.details.otx.detail"
wazuh_detail = "$calc_score.body.details.wazuh.detail"
freq_detail = "$calc_score.body.details.freq.detail"

result = {
    "likely_false_positive": False,
    "fp_confidence": 0,
    "action_confidence": 50,
    "reason": "Fallback decision",
    "decision": "block_auto_action",
    "recommended_action": recommended_action,
    "status": "ok",
    "error": None
}

prompt = f"""
Tu es un analyste SOC senior dans un système SOAR automatisé.

CONTEXTE IMPORTANT SUR LE SYSTEME:
- Ce système a UNE SEULE action automatique possible: BLOQUER l'IP ou QUARANTINER le fichier.
- "allow_auto_action" = l'action de blocage/quarantaine s'exécute IMMÉDIATEMENT sans humain.
- "block_auto_action" = l'alerte est envoyée à un analyste humain pour décision manuelle.

Tu dois retourner DEUX niveaux de confiance distincts:
1. fp_confidence (0-100): à quel point tu es certain que c'est un FAUX POSITIF.
   - 0 = certainement pas un faux positif (alerte réelle)
   - 100 = certainement un faux positif (action automatique dangereuse)
   
2. action_confidence (0-100): à quel point tu es certain que l'action automatique est SÛRE à exécuter.
   - 0 = dangereux d'agir automatiquement (trop ambigu)
   - 100 = très sûr d'exécuter l'action automatiquement

CONTEXTE DE L'ALERTE:
- Playbook: {playbook}
- Action automatique prévue: {recommended_action}
- Agent: {agent_name} ({agent_id})
- Règle: {rule_id} - {rule_desc}
- Niveau Wazuh: {rule_level}
- Fois déclenchée: {firedtimes}
- IP Source: {srcip}

SCORE ENGINE (0-100):
- Score: {score}/100
- Sévérité: {severity}

ENRICHISSEMENTS THREAT INTEL:
- VirusTotal: {vt_detail}
- OTX AlienVault: {otx_detail}
- Wazuh: {wazuh_detail}
- Fréquence: {freq_detail}

RÈGLES STRICTES:
- Si fp_confidence > 60 → likely_false_positive=true ET decision="block_auto_action"
- Si action_confidence > 74 ET fp_confidence < 40 → decision="allow_auto_action"
- Ces règles sont ABSOLUES, pas de contradiction possible.

Réponds UNIQUEMENT en JSON valide:
{{
  "likely_false_positive": true ou false,
  "fp_confidence": 0-100,
  "action_confidence": 0-100,
  "decision": "allow_auto_action" ou "block_auto_action",
  "reason": "raison courte en francais",
  "analyst_note": "note utile pour l analyste humain"
}}
"""

try:
    headers = {
        "Authorization": f"Bearer {GROQ_API_KEY}",
        "Content-Type": "application/json"
    }
    body = {
        "model": GROQ_MODEL,
        "messages": [
            {
                "role": "system",
                "content": "Tu es un analyste SOC senior. Tu réponds uniquement en JSON valide. fp_confidence mesure la probabilité de faux positif. action_confidence mesure la certitude que l'action automatique est sûre. Ces deux valeurs sont indépendantes et ne peuvent pas se contredire avec likely_false_positive et decision."
            },
            {
                "role": "user",
                "content": prompt
            }
        ],
        "temperature": 0.2,
        "response_format": {"type": "json_object"}
    }

    resp = requests.post(GROQ_API, headers=headers, json=body, timeout=30)

    if resp.status_code == 200:
        ai_text = resp.json()["choices"][0]["message"]["content"]
        ai = json.loads(ai_text)

        fp_confidence = int(ai.get("fp_confidence", 0))
        action_confidence = int(ai.get("action_confidence", 50))
        likely_fp = ai.get("likely_false_positive", False)
        decision = ai.get("decision", "block_auto_action")

        # ============= CONSISTENCY FIX =============
        # Rule 1: high fp_confidence always means block
        if fp_confidence > 60:
            likely_fp = True
            decision = "block_auto_action"

        # Rule 2: low action_confidence always means block
        if action_confidence <= 74:
            decision = "block_auto_action"

        # Rule 3: if FP is true, always block
        if likely_fp:
            decision = "block_auto_action"

        result["likely_false_positive"] = likely_fp
        result["fp_confidence"] = fp_confidence
        result["action_confidence"] = action_confidence
        result["decision"] = decision
        result["reason"] = ai.get("reason", "No reason provided")
        result["analyst_note"] = ai.get("analyst_note", "")

    else:
        result["error"] = f"Groq API error {resp.status_code}"
        result["decision"] = "block_auto_action"
        result["likely_false_positive"] = True
        result["fp_confidence"] = 100
        result["action_confidence"] = 0
        result["reason"] = "AI indisponible, blocage de l action automatique par securite"

except Exception as e:
    result["error"] = str(e)
    result["decision"] = "block_auto_action"
    result["likely_false_positive"] = True
    result["fp_confidence"] = 100
    result["action_confidence"] = 0
    result["reason"] = "AI FP check failed, blocage de l action automatique par securite"

print(json.dumps(result, default=str))

import requests
import json

score = str("$calc_score.body.score")
severity = str("$calc_score.body.severity")
srcip = str("$exec.all_fields.data.srcip")
sha256 = str("$exec.all_fields.syscheck.sha256_after")
agent = str("$exec.all_fields.agent.name")
rule_id = str("$exec.all_fields.rule.id")
rule_desc = str("$exec.all_fields.rule.description")
playbook = str("$routeur.body.playbook")
vt_score = str("$calc_score.body.details.vt.score")
otx_score = str("$calc_score.body.details.otx.score")
mitre_score = str("$calc_score.body.details.mitre.score")
freq_score = str("$calc_score.body.details.freq.score")
wazuh_score = str("$calc_score.body.details.wazuh.score")
bonus = str("$calc_score.body.details.bonus")
action = str("$calc_score.body.recommended_action")
thehive_severity = int("$calc_score.body.thehive_severity")
exec_id = str("$exec.id")
vt_malicious = str("$get_vt_ip.body.data.attributes.last_analysis_stats.malicious")
otx_pulses = str("$get_otx_ip.body.pulse_info.count")

if srcip and srcip not in ["", "null", "None", "NULL"]:
    vt_link = "https://www.virustotal.com/gui/ip-address/" + srcip
    otx_link = "https://otx.alienvault.com/indicator/ip/" + srcip
elif sha256 and sha256 not in ["", "null", "None", "NULL"]:
    vt_link = "https://www.virustotal.com/gui/file/" + sha256
    otx_link = "https://otx.alienvault.com/indicator/file/" + sha256
else:
    vt_link = "N/A"
    otx_link = "N/A"

lines = [
    "============================================================",
    "  SOC-SOAR AUTOMATED ANALYSIS REPORT",
    "============================================================",
    "",
    ">> ALERT INFO",
    "   Rule ID     : " + rule_id,
    "   Description : " + rule_desc,
    "   Agent       : " + agent,
    "   Source IP   : " + srcip,
    "   SHA256      : " + sha256,
    "   Playbook    : " + playbook,
    "",
    ">> THREAT INTELLIGENCE",
    "   VirusTotal  : " + vt_malicious + " malicious engines",
    "   VT Link     : " + vt_link,
    "   OTX Pulses  : " + otx_pulses + " pulses",
    "   OTX Link    : " + otx_link,
    "",
    ">> SCORING BREAKDOWN",
    "   Factor            | Score",
    "   ------------------+-------",
    "   Wazuh Level       | " + wazuh_score + "/20",
    "   VirusTotal        | " + vt_score + "/20",
    "   OTX AlienVault    | " + otx_score + "/20",
    "   MITRE             | " + mitre_score + "/20",
    "   Frequency         | " + freq_score + "/20",
    "   Bonus (3+ high)   | " + bonus,
    "   ------------------+-------",
    "   TOTAL             | " + score + "/100 - Severity: " + severity.upper(),
    "",
    ">> RECOMMENDED ACTION",
    "   " + action,
    "",
    "============================================================"
]

description = "\n".join(lines)

payload = {
    "type": "wazuh",
    "source": "shuffle",
    "sourceRef": exec_id,
    "title": "[" + severity.upper() + "] " + rule_desc,
    "description": description,
    "severity": thehive_severity,
    "tags": ["wazuh", severity],
    "tlp": 2
}

try:
    r = requests.post(
        "http://192.168.56.12:9000/api/alert",
        headers={
            "Authorization": "Bearer <THEHIVE_API_KEY>",
            "Content-Type": "application/json"
        },
        json=payload,
        timeout=10,
        verify=False
    )
    print(json.dumps({"status": r.status_code, "body": r.json()}))
except Exception as e:
    print(json.dumps({"status": "error", "body": str(e)}))
